# Shivam Anil Jha

> Shivam Anil Jha (also written Shivam Jha) is an AI architect and full-stack developer from Pune (Pimpri-Chinchwad),
> Maharashtra, India, and the maker of Orbit OS, an open-source (GPL-3.0) smart TV remote and setup app for Google TV
> and Android TV.

## Skills
AI architecture, prompt engineering, generative AI, full-stack development, Flutter and Dart, React, Android TV and
Google TV development, open source.
